name: Ulima
source: Ulima is a recently enrolled PhD student fueled by a desire to excel in her field. While she doesn’t mince her words and isn’t afraid to sacrifice formalities for the sake of efficiency, her studious backbone is often a good sounding board for advice. Though her distain for trivialities may cross out any ‘typical’ form of socializing, she’s often an interesting person to spend time with regardless.
